sources.title: Getting started
sources.finding: Local workspace chats support parallel streaming tabs, persisted attachments and terminal output; automations schedule unattended runs.

sources.title: Sub-agents
sources.finding: Atlarix-owned explore agents research in parallel. Build children propose per-file diffs for main-agent and human approval. Named children expose progress and hard stop.

sources.title: Approvals
sources.finding: Build edits require hunk approval unless allowed; ordinary commands run with per-OS write confinement and network on. Explore and Plan are read-only.

sources.title: Headless CLI
sources.finding: Node 20+ CLI runs on macOS/Linux/Windows with custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and optional timeout; it auto-approves edits and commands subject to dangerous-command policy.

sources.title: Codebase retrieval
sources.finding: Uses on-demand glob and ripgrep, not embeddings or background repository indexing.

sources.title: MCP servers
sources.finding: MCP Registry and custom URL/command/config imports; remote servers sync to account and local endpoints remain per-computer/folder.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.finding: App features are free; BYO API/local models have no Atlarix fee. Pro $19 USD monthly includes $19 model usage; additional paid model credit starts at $10. Free Auto shares prompts with its providers, paid usage does not.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: batch
sources.finding: Native binaries are preferred; unsupported-platform/optional-package fallback is readable Node batch code. Fresh isolated temporary DB by default, no shared desktop DB, optional provider keys and signed-in Core, ask/build and timeout flags; local redacted JSONL trajectory. This is distributed source, not evidence that all compiled desktop/interactive defaults match.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: plans
sources.finding: Session plan UUIDs persist in SQLite with title/content/status; read/write/append/step updates, serialized step edits and copy-to-session. Legacy ledger archives Markdown and records files/tool results. Flat checklist states are not an epic/blocker graph or validated requirements.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: memory
sources.finding: Instructions have bundle/global/workspace/project layers; scoped Markdown memories and bounded index context persist across sessions. Repo skills are read from disk; cache and prompt instructions do not guarantee factual freshness.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: plugins
sources.finding: Readable plugin support loads skills, agents, commands, MCP, approved hooks and JS mods. Install staging hashes and runnable confirmations detect edits; hooks can allow/ask/deny but timeout is not a hard failure gate. Mods run as the user. Claude plugin compatibility does not run Claude Code.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: delegation
sources.finding: Owned subagents use model clients, tool restrictions, proposal isolation, usage totals and background result delivery; default delegation limiter is five per chat/turn with FIFO queue and 750ms stagger. Same-host peer sessions can message/change mode/model/review plans; token-authenticated local IPC and high-risk approval refusal are not organization RBAC.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: scheduler
sources.finding: Local cron/MCP-poll scheduler uses database leases and one process queue; skips overlapping automation, heartbeats every 30 s and marks stale runs interrupted. Execution timeout 10 min. Bundle contains the service, but its batch entry does not start the recurring runner; scheduled wakeups are separately awaited within a batch deadline. Constants impose 10 automations and 10 simultaneously active MCP servers per workspace, independent of plan.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: sandbox
sources.finding: Headless defaults sandbox requested, but unless enforce is true a missing/broken helper falls back to unconfined shell. Seatbelt/bwrap/optional helpers permit workspace, temp and broad tool caches; default network open. Egress isolation depends on mechanism; Windows/helper denied-write protections can be gate-only. No VM/container is created by the batch entry.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: usage
sources.locator: src/lib/stats/usage-report.ts; usage/turn-usage-aggregator.ts; ipc/handlers/chat_stream_handlers.ts; entry trajectory writer
sources.finding: Local usage separates measured/estimated auxiliary tokens; report groups day/model/surface/source and estimated BYO cost. This is not reconciled provider billing or ADEMark performance.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: session
sources.finding: Local SQLite session search and portable Markdown/JSON export helpers preserve prose and summarized tools, omit thoughts and can redact common secrets. Same-machine continuation launches CLI/editor with session identity; not runtime migration or lossless context.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: loop
sources.finding: Completion returns mutation/verification or stop-hook feedback for at most three nudges, then can end despite remaining feedback. Hook failure to run is logged and not fail-closed. Context compaction and repetition guards are not spend caps.

sources.title: Published Atlarix batch runtime: telemetry
sources.finding: Batch runtime sets product analytics opted_out, but signed-in client usage still queues record_client_usage every 15 min unless ATLARIX_HOST_TELEMETRY=off; account seen uses the same separate gate. Local accountless batch has no sending session. Sentry stub has no initialized DSN in this entry. Ordinary source consent unset counts as analytics enabled when a PostHog key is supplied.

sources.title: Published editor extension
sources.locator: dist/extension.js wf, activate, setHostTelemetry, ACP client, permission/diff callbacks; package.json
sources.finding: Bundled or configured compiled agent runs ACP. VS Code telemetry false sets ATLARIX_HOST_TELEMETRY=off and live changes call _atlarix/host_telemetry. Requests and permission diffs are routed through editor UI; agent binary implementation remains separate.

sources.title: Published Chrome extension
sources.locator: manifest.json; background.js bridge/account-gate/native-port; sidepanel.js syncableRows/pushConversation, approvals, paid model stream, notes, connectors; sandbox/runner scripts
sources.finding: Chrome 116+ v15.19.4 has required web host permissions and local native bridge, paid hosted model requests, Supabase conversation/note/site-grant sync and local sandbox file generation. Full text endpoint/analytics/telemetry/PostHog/Sentry search across shipped JS found no separate analytics/crash client; functional sync and inference remain network traffic.
